brand.name: Hypeless
brand.promise: What it does. What it costs. The catch.
brand.one_liner: New AI tools, GitHub repos and AI news, explained in under a minute.

setup_order: Brand Gmail: one new Gmail used for every account below. Turn on 2-step verification. Save all logins in a password manager.
YouTube: sign in with the brand Gmail, create the channel 'Hypeless', claim the handle @hypeless.
Facebook Page: from your personal Facebook, create the Page 'Hypeless' (Meta requires a personal admin; it stays private).
Instagram: sign up as hypeless (brand Gmail), switch to a Professional (Creator) account, then link it to the Facebook Page.
TikTok: sign up as hypeless (brand Gmail), then switch to a Business account.
X: sign up as hypeless (brand Gmail).
Same handle everywhere. If hypeless is taken on any platform, use hypelessai on ALL of them.

settings: Settings > Channel > Basic info: Country = Pakistan (your real country; YouTube Partner Program payouts and tax use it).
Settings > Channel > Advanced settings: audience = 'No, set this channel as not made for kids'.
Settings > Upload defaults: Category = Science & Technology, Video language = English, Comments = 'Hold potentially inappropriate comments for review'.
Verify your phone number (Settings > Channel > Feature eligibility) to unlock custom thumbnails, longer videos and links.

Per video, 'Altered or synthetic content' = No. A generic AI narrator over real screen footage needs no label under YouTube's rules. Answer Yes only if a video shows realistic AI-made people or events, or uses AI-generated music.

settings: Settings > Account type and tools > Switch to professional account > Creator. Auto-posting only works on Professional accounts.
Link to the Facebook Page: Accounts Center > Accounts > Add accounts (or from the Page: Settings > Linked accounts > Instagram).
AI label: Meta's rule covers 'realistic-sounding audio that was digitally created', and our narrator is an AI voice, so the safe choice is to switch on 'AI info' when posting.

settings: Settings > Account > Switch to Business account. You get the website link without needing 1,000 followers, plus analytics. Creator Rewards isn't offered in Pakistan, so you lose nothing, and our videos carry their own music.
Business category: Software & Apps, or the closest tech/education option.

AI-generated content label: off. TikTok's guidelines (updated 24 Sep 2026) say generic text-to-speech narration needs no label. Turn it on only for realistic AI people or scenes, or a voice that mimics a real person.
